by
  have : ∀ g : G, ∃ n : ℕ, g ^ n = 1 := hG
  let f : G ≅ ⨁ i : ℕ, ℤ / (n_i • ℤ) :=
    let n : ℕ := 0
    let f' : G ≅ ⨁ i : ℕ, ℤ / (n_i • ℤ) :=
      by
        refine (finsupp.fg_abelian_group_equiv _ _ _)
        exact Group.FG.fg_abelian_group G
        exact (comm_group.to_abelian_group G).is_abelian
  let f' : ∀ i : ℕ, ℤ / (n_i • ℤ) ≅ Fin n_i :=
    by
      intro i
      refine (ring_theory.ideal.quotient_is_cyclic _ _ _)
      exact (ring_theory.ideal.quotient_is_cyclic.is_cyclic (n_i • ℤ))
      exact (ring_theory.ideal.quotient_is_cyclic.is_cyclic.is_finite)
  let f'' : Finite (⨁ i : ℕ, Fin n_i) :=
    by
      constructor
      apply finite_direct_sum
      intro i
      apply finite_fin
  exact f''
